scientific_integrity: The analytic renewal identity is established literature; only the finite-state sign comparison and its perturbative persistence are claimed as new. Historical priority remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Only the local zero-rate response for N=1,2,3,4 on the stated five-vertex reflecting path is certified; no global optimal-reset or all-N claim. Continuous-time jumps rate one; common synchronous resetting; exact rational finite-state proof, no independent audit.
title: A four-searcher reversal of infinitesimal collective resetting on a five-vertex path
